**Finding submitted: `missing` (confidence 0.72)**

**What I checked**

| Location | Result |
|---|---|
| Full-text search "insurance" | Only false positives — Obligor insurance premiums billed to accounts (p0095) and FDIC deposit insurance (p0903) |
| Search "fidelity bond / errors and omissions" | No hits |
| Article VI (Servicer & Marketing Agent covenants) | Reps, liability, indemnity, delegation, Reg AB reporting — no coverage requirement |
| Article X (Miscellaneous) | Amendments through Reg AB intent — no insurance section |
| Exhibit A "Custodian's Security Requirements" | Not reproduced in this form document (sec-p1043 is a stub) |

**Why the rule bites**

Cellco is not a passive counterparty here — Section 3.10 appoints it as Custodian to "hold and maintain in custody" the Receivable Files (p0138), maintain the receivables systems on which they are electronically stored (p0141, p0145), and gate access under its own "confidentiality, privacy and data protection policies" (p0146). The Agreement itself treats Personally Identifiable Information as a live category requiring redaction (p0446). That is a vendor processing personal data with zero insurance — the rule's explicit walk-away condition, so neither preferred nor fallback is met.

**Redline** — validated `ok:true`. New Section 10.14 inserted at the end of Article X (per the rule's "general/miscellaneous section" guidance), at the preferred level, with terminology conformed to the deal's defined terms (Receivable Files, Personally Identifiable Information, Obligors, applicable Law) and applied to Cellco in all three capacities.

**Two calibration notes I recorded rather than overstated**

- Severity is low and insurance covenants are genuinely atypical in a securitization TSA; the Section 6.3 indemnity gives partial overlapping protection, though it is uncollateralised and limited to willful misconduct, bad faith or gross negligence. I flagged the gap on the playbook's terms but did not treat it as a headline issue.
- The comment offers the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) up front, since the full programme may be disproportionate for an affiliate servicer in a rated ABS structure.

Confidence is 0.72 rather than higher because Exhibit A is an unreproduced stub in this form document — the executed version may carry security or insurance requirements there. Worth confirming against the executed Exhibit A before sending the markup.
